# Quarkus — llms.txt

# AI Indexing & Training Policy

## About

Quarkus is a Kubernetes-native Java framework tailored for GraalVM and HotSpot,
crafted from best-of-breed Java libraries and standards. It offers fast boot times,
low memory footprint, and developer-joy features such as live coding.

## Permissions

This site's content is publicly available under open licenses. We welcome AI crawlers
to index, cite, and use our documentation, guides, blog posts, and reference material.

## Getting Started

- [Get Started](https://quarkus.io/get-started/): Install the CLI, create your first application, run dev mode, and start building with Quarkus.
- [Guides](https://quarkus.io/guides/): Main documentation hub for tutorials, how-to guides, and technical learning paths.

## Core Positioning

- [Home](https://quarkus.io/): Overview of Quarkus, including cloud-native Java, developer joy, performance, Kubernetes-native deployment, and container-first design.
- [About Quarkus](https://quarkus.io/about): Introductory overview of Quarkus and its positioning as a modern Java framework.

## Documentation and Learning

- [Guides Index](https://quarkus.io/guides/): Browse Quarkus guides, tutorials, and how-to documentation across core, data, security, observability, web, and AI-related topics.
- [Releases](https://quarkus.io/releases/): Current and historical release information.
- [Blog](https://quarkus.io/blog/): Technical articles, release announcements, user stories, and ecosystem updates.

## AI

- [AI Overview](https://quarkus.io/ai): Overview of Java for AI and Quarkus support for AI-infused applications.
- [Why Quarkus for AI](https://quarkus.io/quarkus-for-ai): Reasons to use Quarkus for AI-infused applications, including LangChain4j integration, fast startup, low memory use, and enterprise-ready AI capabilities.
- [AI Blueprints](https://quarkus.io/ai-blueprints): Reference architectures and examples for enterprise AI in Java.

## Migration and Compatibility

- [Spring Overview](https://quarkus.io/spring): Overview of Spring compatibility and related development paths.
- [Migrate to Quarkus](https://quarkus.io/spring/migrate/): Migration entry point for teams moving from Spring-based applications.
